requirements: R1: Replace the missing MinIO Docker image tag in docker-compose.yml so that the product runtime environment boots successfully.

slices.title: Resolve missing MinIO Docker image tag
slices.jtbd: When implementing the docker-compose fix for this epic, I want to replace the missing minio image tag with a valid one, so that the falsification finding is resolved and the environment boots successfully.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the docker-compose.yml file contains an invalid minio image tag
When the tag is updated to a valid existing minio/minio tag
Then docker compose pull object-storage completes successfully without 'not found' errors
Given the updated configuration
When the system is started
Then the minio container boots up successfully
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce environment boot failures due to missing image from 1 to 0
